title: Embrace the Chaos of Your life | Art Tutorial
description: An art tutorial turns creative blockage into a chaotic letting-go exercise: Choe layers paint, prescribes play rather than a cure, struggles with the urge to protect valuable objects and ends amid jokes about damaged trading cards.
summary: An art tutorial turns creative blockage into a chaotic letting-go exercise: Choe layers paint, prescribes play rather than a cure, struggles with the urge to protect valuable objects and ends amid jokes about damaged trading cards.
